arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = "table"

SELECT "outbox" AS source, json_object("event_id",o.event_id,"booking_id",o.booking_id,"payload",o.payload,"status",o.status,"attempts",o.attempts) AS data FROM outbox o WHERE o.status != "delivered" UNION ALL SELECT "booking", json_object("booking_id",b.booking_id,"request_id",b.request_id,"flight_id",b.flight_id,"passenger_id",b.passenger_id,"amount_cents",b.amount_cents,"status",b.status,"client_reference",b.client_reference) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status != "confirmed" UNION ALL SELECT "customer_event",json_object("event_id",event_id,"request_id",request_id,"kind",kind,"step",step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT "config:" || service, value FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT "cache:" || key, value FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT "fare_hold", json_object("flight_id",flight_id,"price_cents",price_cents,"until_step",until_step) FROM fare_holds
